description: This file defines the UnroutedUrlAssembler class in Drupal, responsible for constructing external and local URLs with support for protocols, path processing, and URL options.

classes.name: UnroutedUrlAssembler
classes.description: A class for building external or non-Drupal local domain URLs, considering safe HTTP protocols and path processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the assembler with request stack, path processor, and optional protocols.

methods.name: assemble
methods.description: Determines whether to build a local or external URL based on the URI scheme.

methods.name: buildExternalUrl
methods.description: Constructs an external URL, handling query parameters, fragments, and HTTPS options.

methods.name: buildLocalUrl
methods.description: Constructs a local URL, considering path processing, base path, and absolute URL options.

methods.name: addOptionDefaults
methods.description: Merges default options into URL options, including script name and path.
